name: Elarin
title: Keeper of the Outward House
examine: The one elf in Evenfall who likes travelers, keeping the one building raised in a hundred and fifty years. He collects human idioms and uses them slightly wrong, on purpose, probably.
lines: Welcome to the Outward House. As you humans say: make yourself at house.
I built this inn myself, forty years ago, to be ready. The whole city said the gate would never open. The whole city helps me sweep it now.
The stew is my own recipe. It is one hundred and six years old. The stew, not the pot. The pot is older.
